headline: Bitcoin fell to about $63,400 late Saturday, its weakest level since August, as a wave of forced selling hit leveraged traders and markets priced in a near-certain Fed rate hike in December.

market.asOf: CoinGecko coin pages read at about 00:05 UTC Sun 15 Nov (07:05 Bangkok). Prices have moved since; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear, but indexes differ: alternative.me's Crypto Fear and Greed Index shows 13 (20 a day earlier), while CoinMarketCap's Fear and Greed Index shows 16 out of 100, both read at about 00:05 UTC Sunday.

stories.title: Bitcoin hits a fresh three-month low near $63,400 as a late-night wave of forced selling hits
stories.summary: Selling got worse late on Saturday. Bitcoin touched about $63,400, its weakest level since August, and ether slipped under $1,800. In one hour, hundreds of millions of dollars of borrowed bets on rising prices were closed automatically.
points: Bitcoin touched a fresh three-month low of $63,400, per CoinDesk; Investing.com put the intraday low at $63,403.1, its weakest level since August.
About $691M of crypto bets were liquidated (force-closed) in a single hour, $671M of them bets on rising prices, per TokenPost.
Over 24 hours, liquidations totalled about $1.47B, including $1.31B of bets on rising prices, per CoinGlass data cited by Investing.com; CryptoTicker's count was lower, at about $1B.
Ether fell to $1,746 at 5:52pm ET, down 9.60% in 24 hours, per TokenPost.
At 23:03 UTC, CoinGecko data showed bitcoin 49.6% below its record of $126,080 and the total crypto market at about $2.16T, per CryptoTicker.

stories.title: Bitcoin funds lose over $1B for a second straight week, with seven days of withdrawals in a row
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, the way many Americans hold bitcoin in a brokerage account, saw more money leave than arrive for a second week running. When fund holders sell, the fund sells bitcoin, removing buying support.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs had $1.07B of net outflows last week, per The Block.
The funds have seen outflows for seven straight trading days, per The Block.
BlackRock's IBIT lost $143.5M on Friday, about 77% of that day's outflows, per The Block.
Spot ether ETFs lost $398.9M on the week, their seventh losing week in a row, per The Block.

stories.title: Markets now price a December Fed rate hike as close to certain
stories.summary: Higher interest rates make borrowing more expensive and tend to pull money away from riskier assets such as crypto. After hotter-than-expected inflation and jobs data, futures markets now expect the Fed to raise rates at its 8-9 December meeting rather than hold. These are market bets, not a Fed decision.
points: CME FedWatch showed 88.5% odds of a quarter-point hike in December and 11.5% for a half-point hike, per Bitcoin.com News.
Prediction markets agreed: Kalshi at 89% and Polymarket at 88% for a quarter-point hike, per Bitcoin.com News.
October consumer prices rose 0.4% against a 0.3% forecast, and payrolls rose 165,000 against about 65,000 expected, per Bitcoin.com News.
The Fed's target range is currently 3.75% to 4.00%, per the Fed.

sources.label: Bitcoin.com News: hike odds near certain

briefs.title: Kava Lend hacked for about $3.8M
briefs.summary: An attacker drained about 55.2M KAVA through a dormant BUSD market, and the KAVA token fell nearly 40%, per The Block.

briefs.title: Binance reopens withdrawals on 87 networks
briefs.summary: After the 29 October hack, Binance reopened 87 networks and aims to restore all remaining networks and assets by the end of next week, per Coinpaper.

briefs.title: Altcoins fall harder than bitcoin
briefs.summary: XRP fell 9.1%, solana 10.9%, dogecoin 10.4% and cardano 11.7% on Saturday, per Investing.com.

briefs.title: Stablecoin supply shrinks by a record amount
briefs.summary: The supply of USDT, USDC and DAI fell by a record $11.5B over 30 days, per Coinbase Institutional data cited by Coinpaper.

briefs.title: Options hedging may be making swings bigger
briefs.summary: Options dealers are positioned so their hedging adds to price moves for bitcoin between about $58,000 and $72,000, per Greeks.Live data reported by CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Louisiana's attorney general hits back at the CFTC
briefs.summary: After the CFTC sued the state over prediction markets, Louisiana's AG called CFTC chair Michael Selig an "obsequious standard bearer" for the industry, per The Block.

briefs.title: Meta tests a prediction-market app
briefs.summary: Meta is testing a prediction-market app that uses "cred" points instead of cash, per the WSJ via The Block.

calendar.event: Token unlocks: ARB, SEI, STRK, CRO, ZK, PENGU, ZRO, KAITO, AKE, MORPHO
calendar.note: ARB, SEI and STRK unlock on Sunday 15 November. See the unlock table on this page for sizes, dates and confidence.
At Olympia London, the first Breakpoint held in the UK, per Solana Compass.
Consensus 19, per Economic Weekly; prior 25.5, per the New York Fed. Fed's Williams speaks at 9:05am ET (21:05 Bangkok), per Finviz.

calendar.event: Fed Chair Warsh gives opening remarks
calendar.note: At the Productivity and Jobs Task Force conference at the San Francisco Fed, 9:00am PT, per the San Francisco Fed.

Forecasts differ: +0.2% per Newsquawk and Economic Weekly, 0% per Forex Fundamentals; prior +0.8%. Industrial production at 9:15am ET (consensus +0.1%, per Economic Weekly). Fed's Waller speaks at 9:20am ET, per Finviz.

Call at 5pm ET (05:00 Wed Bangkok), per Nvidia. Revenue forecasts: about $109.2B per LSEG data cited by IG, $108.84B per MarketPulse. First results since Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO on 12 November, per IG.

calendar.event: Fed minutes from the October meeting
calendar.note: Minutes of the October meeting, where rates were held at 3.75-4.00% on a 10-2 vote; Cook and Hammack dissented in favour of a hike, per the Fed. Bullish (BLSH) reports Q3 results the same day, with a call at 8:30am ET.

calendar.event: Anthropic shares expected to start trading
calendar.note: Nasdaq ticker ANT, range $70-78 a share, per RTTNews; up to $64.4B raised at the top of the range, per The Next Web, which expects trading to start Thursday.

calendar.event: US jobless claims and Philly Fed survey
calendar.note: Claims consensus 197,000 per Economic Weekly (200,000 per Finviz), prior 200,000; Philly Fed consensus 23 (prior 20.9), per Economic Weekly. Walmart's results materials are due about 6:00am CT (7:00am ET), with a call at 7:00am CT, per Walmart. Goolsbee speaks at 12:30pm ET (00:30 Fri Bangkok), per Finviz.

calendar.event: University of Michigan consumer sentiment (Nov, final)
calendar.note: Consensus 53.3, per Economic Weekly; preliminary reading 51.0 (October 48.0), per StockAnalysis. Monthly US stock options expire the same day. Fed's Cook speaks at 12:15pm ET (00:15 Sat Bangkok), per Finviz.
Decision Wed 9 Dec at 2:00pm ET (02:00 Thu Bangkok), press conference 2:30pm ET, per the Fed.
